facts.fact: Nafeza, described as Egypt's national single window for foreign trade, is live in production with the Ain Sokhna truck yard system and supplies cargo clearance and release status, per Egytrans Nosco's Abir Leheta.

systems.system: Nafith truck-management yard system, Ain Sokhna

facts.fact: EnterpriseAM describes Nafeza as Egypt's national single window for foreign trade, designed as a single window for the approval process rather than separate portals, with over 30k registered importers and about 80k foreign exporters filing information.
Nafeza is the electronic system governing sea and air freight, with advance cargo information mandatory at seaports since October 2021 and on air freight from January 2026.

The Finance Ministry has begun surveying road-freight firms to register and link them electronically to Nafeza, starting at Nuweiba and Safaga, with consolidated bills of lading and pre-arrival cargo data for land freight, per three officials.

note: Only electronic customs collections are stated, not a customs clearance system.

facts.fact: Arqam reports Egypt's customs authority will run its automated classification and valuation system at all customs sites as a test environment, with mandatory use from 1 October 2025 and a link to E-Finance's database.
Egypt's progress report to the WTO of 3 May 2024 says the Nafeza national single window is activated in most customs ports and electronically linked to most of the border agencies concerned.

note: The MoU covers biometric border gates and e-passports, not a customs declaration system.
Database record only; its single window claim is held.

facts.fact: Mubasher, reporting Egypt's Cabinet information centre (IDSC), says the Finance Ministry finished automating 50 customs applications for imports and exports on the unified Nafeza platform in June 2023, and that Nafeza covers 99.9% of imports and exports through 15 logistics centres.
